theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) : (n ^ 2 + n) % 2 = 0 := by
  by_cases h : n % 2 = 0
  · have : (n ^ 2 + n) % 2 = 0 :=
      calc
        (n ^ 2 + n) % 2 = (n * n + n) % 2 := rfl
        ... = n * n % 2 + n % 2 : by rw [Nat.add_mod]
        ... = 0 + 0 : by rw [Nat.mul_mod, Nat.mod_eq_iff_div_eq h, Nat.mod_eq_iff_div_eq h]
        ... = 0 : by rw [Nat.add_zero]
    exact this
  · have h1 : n % 2 = 1 := Eq.trans h (Nat.mod_eq_iff_div_eq h).mp
    have : (n ^ 2 + n) % 2 = 0 :=
      calc
        (n ^ 2 + n) % 2 = (n * n + n) % 2 := rfl
        ... = n * n % 2 + n % 2 : by rw [Nat.add_mod]
        ... = 1 + 1 : by rw [Nat.mul_mod, Nat.mod_eq_iff_div_eq h1, Nat.mod_eq_iff_div_eq h1]
        ... = 2 % 2 : by rw [Nat.add_right_inj, Nat.add_self_eq_twice]
        ... = 0 : by rw [Nat.two_mod]
    exact this
